scope: The permanent exterior of the Arctic and Antarctic Museum in the former St. Nicholas Edinoverie Church in Saint Petersburg, in its circa-2008 museum configuration. Includes the mapped four projecting fronts, the principal Marata approach, two-tier classical massing and green central dome. The separate chapels, interiors and temporary restoration works are outside this model.

originalReview.notes: The green hemispherical roof, cap, raised base, street-facing overall mass and relative tiers are visible above and through scaffolding. Façade detail is obscured. The foreground chapel and restoration works are excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla was checked first. One exact photographer-released public-domain image covers the dome and overall mass. Other local files depict exhibits. Non-public-domain and unverified archive views were excluded. The permanent porticoes and facade divisions are interpreted from the native building outline and named written sources.
